name: Insight Meditation South Bay
reason: No usable photo: imsb.org has no hall of its own (it meets in churches in Mountain View, Los Altos and Saratoga), its only logo is a 365x22 text banner, other images are Shaila Catherine's portrait, her book cover and landscape art, and the site links no YouTube channel. Every current programme (2027 retreats in California and Georgia, half-day sittings, online courses via Bodhi Courses) is taught by its founder Shaila Catherine, already on Spiritpedia with the same videos, so as a separate listing it would largely duplicate hers. Owner may revisit: published contact is sit@imsb.org (domain part shown as an image) on https://www.imsb.org/about-us/contact-us/.
